gui_forms::Timer.summary: Timer schedules coalescing callbacks through the owning Window scheduler and serializes ticks with input, layout, and paint on the UI thread.
remarks: Binds to one live Window and emits `tick` on that Window's UI thread. The interval is at least 1 ms; `start`, deterministic `start_at`, `stop`, and interval mutation are supported.
Late deadlines coalesce to one callback while preserving cadence and registration order. Rendering occlusion does not suspend component time; disabled timers publish no wake.
This is not a background worker: stop, component disposal, and Window shutdown synchronously revoke future callbacks.
gui_forms::Timer.ownership: A nonvisual `Component`. The application owns it directly or through a `ComponentContainer`; it binds to one live Window and never becomes part of the visual tree. Disposal is synchronous and idempotent and revokes every outstanding callback before teardown.
gui_forms::Timer.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::Timer.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
